caption: The drawing depicts a metal railing, likely made of wrought iron, shown in front view. The railing features an intricate design incorporating vine motifs, with several clusters of grapes and grape leaves distributed symmetrically along its length. The color palette consists primarily of shades of gray and brown, giving the ironwork a metallic appearance, while the background is a light beige with subtle blue-gray shading representing a stone wall. The stone wall behind the railing has slightly visible lines suggesting blocks or bricks, and faint, partially obscured text can be seen in the upper middle section. The railing is bordered by a rectangular frame, and at each upper corner there is a decorative element resembling a pointed spearhead with a spiral design at the base. The bottom of the railing frame is supported by two simple brackets projecting from the wall, also depicted in gray tones. Shadows are visible below the frame and brackets, indicating a light source from the upper left.
title: Cast Iron Railing
